newsitem.title: CANADA: Caledonia Mining halts Barbrook Mine.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia Mining halts Barbrook Mine.

text.p: Caledonia Mining Corp said on Monday that it suspended production at its Barbrook mine in South Africa due to low gold prices.
Underground operations were suspended immediately while milling operations would continue for a short time until the surface stockpile was processed, the company said in a statement.
About 105,000 tonnes of mine reserves are available when mining recommences, Toronto-based Caledonia said.
"The decision as to when the mine will be reopened will depend upon a sustainable economic gold price and internal studies regarding mill modifications," the statement said.
Gold prices tumbled earlier this month on news that the Reserve Bank of Australia sold 167 tonnes of gold reserves over the past six months.
COMEX gold prices ended lower on Monday with August gold down US$3.40 at US$326.20 an ounce.
